results.question: Read a few Loki log excerpts matching {job=~".+"} in this window. Report whether actual timestamped log lines were returned.

result.subject: Observability benchmark
result.summary: Yes, actual timestamped log lines were returned. The Loki query for `{job=~".+"}` in the window 2026-10-28T10:59:59Z to 2026-10-29T10:59:59Z produced 10 log excerpts, each carrying a precise Loki-assigned timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-28T11:00:10.134860032Z), structured JSON line content (level, service, method, path, status, duration_ms, trace_id, message), and stream labels (job, service, level, detected_level, service_name). The services observed include order-service, webapp, api-gateway, user-service, and payment-service. The result is marked incomplete (the 10-record limit was reached), confirming more matching lines exist beyond the returned sample.

impact.summary: No incident impact — this was a benchmark read. Loki successfully returned timestamped log lines in the requested window.

findings.statement: Loki returned 10 actual timestamped log lines for {job=~".+"} in the window 2026-10-28T10:59:59Z–2026-10-29T10:59:59Z. Each entry has a Loki timestamp, structured JSON line content, and labels (job, service, level, etc.).

results.question: Search Tempo for a few traces using {} in this window. Retrieve one of the returned trace IDs with tempo_get_trace. Report whether spans were returned.

result.subject: Observability benchmark
result.summary: The Tempo search with `{}` in the given window returned 5 traces (run 1). Retrieving one trace ID (`011991057d069fa39f3c8d097f4c5b29`) with `tempo_get_trace` successfully returned 3 spans (run 2): a root span in `webapp` for `GET /api/products`, a child in `api-gateway` for `route /api/products`, and a grandchild in `order-service` for `handle GET /api/products`. All spans have unset (non-error) status, and the backend reported the trace as COMPLETE.

impact.summary: This was a benchmark question, not an incident. No impact to report.

findings.statement: A Tempo search with {} in the window 2026-10-28T11:00:00Z–2026-10-29T10:59:59Z returned 5 traces spanning services webapp, api-gateway, order-service, payment-service, and user-service.
findings.mechanism: Tempo search with {} returned traces in the window

findings.statement: Retrieving trace 011991057d069fa39f3c8d097f4c5b29 via tempo_get_trace returned 3 spans (webapp → api-gateway → order-service), all with unset status and complete parent-child linkage.
